text:
```yaml
name: Java Snippet Validation

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh'
      - 'scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh'
      - '.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh'
      - 'scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh'
      - '.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml'

jobs:
  validate-snippets:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'adopt'

      - name: Make scripts executable
        run: chmod +x scripts/*.sh

      - name: Extract Java snippets
        id: extract_snippets
        run: |
          ./scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh CodenameOne/src > snippets.jsonl

      - name: Validate snippets
        run: |
          cat snippets.jsonl | xargs -I {} ./scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh {}
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml` sets up a job to validate Java snippets extracted from Javadoc comments. It includes steps to checkout the repository, set up Java, make scripts executable, extract snippets, and validate them using the existing playground harness. The workflow is triggered on pushes or pull requests affecting specified paths related to the snippet tooling and validation scripts.
